name: Cubes Canes & Joy Vegas 2024

venue.name: Twitchell Elementary School
venue.details: The competition will be held in the cafeteria.

information: We are exited to keep the cubing momentum going with Cubes Canes & Joy Vegas 2024! We look forward to making new friends and welcoming back our veteran solvers. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubesCanesJoyVegas2024#47590-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](http://westcoastcubing.com), sponsored by [TheCubicle](https://thecubicle.us) and [Raising Cane's Chicken Fingers](https://raisingcanes.com/home/): [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzk2MzcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--058eb6766f3c5d4ad04238b6fa2ed4bbd57f4932/wccTCCanes.png)](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubesCanesJoyVegas2024#46874-sponsorship) **More on this event including additional Information, Lunch and Live Results can be found on individual tabs above. Be sure to check out our Sponsors page!**
